nodes.name: Adapteraufruf Platzhalter
nodes.notes: Hier wird ab Phase 1.1 der freigegebene Adapter aufgerufen. In Phase 1.0 unerreichbar, weil kein Werkzeug auf approved steht.

parameters.query: SELECT (r.tool_id IS NOT NULL) AS found, r.status AS tool_status, r.risk_class_default::text AS registry_class, coalesce($3 = ANY (r.allowed_contexts), false) AS context_allowed, r.readback_supported, r.accepted_methods, r.evidence_limitation, (SELECT count(*) FROM jarvis_ops.tool_registry x WHERE x.tool_id = $1)::int AS versions_known FROM (SELECT 1) AS eins LEFT JOIN jarvis_ops.tool_registry r ON r.tool_id = $1 AND r.version = $2
